title: Invite friends
lede: A friend who signs up with your code gets 50 credits after finishing the guide and creating a first project. If they accept a first delivery within 7 days of signing up, they get 100 more, and you get 150 credits.

code.title: Your invite code
code.label: Invite code
code.unlockHint: Accept your first delivery to add {n} more seats

earned.title: Rewards earned
earned.note: Invitations earn at most 1,500 credits a month; once you reach it, friends who get started that month earn you nothing more. Credits last 365 days from when they are paid and are used after the month's plan credits.
